name: Tools of Engagement
source: Three things that would turn your perfect life upside-down: 1) Falling for Wes Daniels, the sexy cowboy-turned-construction worker raising an adorable little girl on his own. 2) Leaving the family business and starting your own home renovation project from scratch on the worst, ugliest house in town. 3) Doing all of this... on reality TV!
translation: 三件事将让你完美的人生天翻地覆。第一，爱上韦斯·丹尼尔斯，这个性感的前牛仔，如今是建筑工人，独自抚养着一个可爱的小女孩。第二，离开家族企业，从零开始，翻修镇上最糟、最丑的房子。第三，这一切……都要在电视真人秀上进行！
